segments.text:
V. 24.
I will aſk you one thing—Who have aſked me many: The baptiſm, that is, the whole Miniſtry, of John, was it from heaven, or from men?—By what Authority did he act and teach? Did Man or GOD give him that Authority? Was it not GOD? But if ſo, the Conſequence was clear. For John teſtified, that Jeſus was the Chiſt.
